description: Figshare public article search (public API, no key): id, title, DOI, publication date, item type and public page link for research articles, datasets and figures. Searches titles and metadata; file contents are not returned. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_al_jazeera_articles when you need Al Jazeera latest articles from its public RSS feed; search_bbc_news_articles when you need BBC News top stories from the public BBC RSS feed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: search_figshare_articles
title: Figshare public article search: id, title, DOI, publication
